title: Beet and Northern Irish Cheese Gratin with Japanese Twist
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with the richness of an Irish-inspired gratin, featuring roasted beets and northern Irish cheese.

ingredients.name: Northern Irish Cheese (such as Cashel Blue or Dunloe)

instructions: Peel and slice the roasted beets into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the sake, whisking continuously, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the honey and thyme.
Arrange a layer of beets in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with a layer of the sake mixture, followed by a sprinkle of cheese.
Repeat this process two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Serve warm, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
